  <title>59 new Erasmus+ projects selected on international cooperation in vocational education and training</title>
  <link>https://erasmus-plus.ec.europa.eu/whats-new/news/59-new-erasmus-projects-selected-on-international-cooperation-in-vocational-education-and-training</link>
  <description>
<h1 class="title-h1 eac-page-title">59 new Erasmus+ projects selected on international cooperation in vocational education and training</h1>
<span><span>holbobe</span></span>
<span><time datetime="2026-10-09T12:49:22+02:00" title="Friday, October 9, 2026 - 12:49">Fri, 10/09/2026 - 12:49</time>
</span>
<div class="ecl"><h2>Capacity building in vocational education and training</h2><p>Funded projects on capacity building in vocational education and training (VET) support cooperation between European and non-European VET organisations and close the gaps between VET and market opportunities. They are mostly targeting countries outside Europe.</p><h2>Commitment to global partnerships</h2><p>More than 28 million Euros has been allocated to the 59 new projects, covering 68 countries and selected from a record number of eligible evaluated proposals.</p><p>The projects aim to create bridges to advance VET systems globally through knowledge exchange and mutual growth. They show again how the Erasmus+ programme is committed to building global partnerships beyond the EU.</p><p>Partnerships involve European VET organisations and their counterparts in the Western Balkans, South and East neighbouring countries, Sub-Saharan Africa, Latin America and the Caribbeans.</p><h2>2026 highlights</h2><h3>Cross-border digital innovation</h3><p>Projects are pioneering the next generation of digital learning tools by sharing technological advancements and best practices in digital education to benefit learners across continents.</p><h3>Sustainability beyond borders</h3><p>Addressing global challenges requires global solutions. Projects focused on green skills development are engaging international partners to create a more sustainable future. This includes joint programmes on renewable energy technologies, sustainable agricultural practices, and eco-conscious entrepreneurship.</p><h3>Strengthening global networks</h3><p>The collaborative nature of these projects strengthens global networks of educators, VET learners, and industry experts. They provide a platform for exchanging ideas, methodologies and resources, enriching the educational experiences of all participants.</p><h2>Impact and expectations</h2><p>Collaborations are expected to improve the employability and skill levels of learners and raise trainers’ competencies both within Europe and in partner countries. By aligning vocational training with global industry trends and labour market needs, the projects contribute to economic growth and social development across continents.</p><h2>Project examples</h2><ul><li data-list-item-id="e40b1df40d17cd352df52167a33365e04">Strengthening Vocational Education and Training for flood management, climate resilience and crisis preparedness in Latin America</li><li data-list-item-id="e5514f0b5d7fee3ea4e2678b34ed0153d">Transition towards a reconstruction-ready VET Teaching workforce in Ukraine</li><li data-list-item-id="e714879f560455a320251419d0ff7214c">Strengthening VET in Green Entrepreneurship for Young Women in the Fashion Industry in Tunisia and Morocco</li><li data-list-item-id="e6aa3da10f40feba048280886bdd8ffe6">Ophthalmic Nurse Technician Training in Sub-Saharan Africa</li><li data-list-item-id="ef5b4dde0d47fe93c763c79946cb3d17e">Transforming TVET for Waste-to-Energy Skills in East Africa</li><li data-list-item-id="ebec65cc22dc3c2bf432ef9a35955ecd6">Drone Pilot Training for Precision Irrigation and Water-Smart Agriculture in the Western Balkans</li><li data-list-item-id="ee51c6050bcc869adb4cac83393660aee">Digital Quality Assurance and Graduate Tracking for Labour Market Responsive VET in Albania</li></ul></div>
<div class="ecl-u-type-bold ecl-u-mb-m">Intro Text</div><div class="eac-hero"><p>Newly selected international partnerships aim to align vocational training with industry trends and labour market needs, and help learners across Europe and beyond gain more skills that employers are seeking.</p></div>

  <title>European Student Card Initiative at EAIE 2026 in Glasgow - main highlights</title>
  <link>https://erasmus-plus.ec.europa.eu/european-student-card-initiative/news/european-student-card-initiative-at-eaie-2026-in-glasgow-main-highlights</link>
  <description>
<h1 class="title-h1 eac-page-title">European Student Card Initiative at EAIE 2026 in Glasgow - main highlights</h1>
<span><span>holbobe</span></span>
<span><time datetime="2026-09-30T09:11:45+02:00" title="Wednesday, September 30, 2026 - 09:11">Wed, 09/30/2026 - 09:11</time>
</span>
<div class="ecl"><p>EAIE 2026 took place from 8 to 11 September, with this year’s theme being “The Rhythm of Revolution”. ESCI featured in five activities: two sessions in the main conference programme and three mini-sessions at the European Commission stand.</p><h2>Shaping the next phase of the ESCI</h2><p>The session “What’s next for the European Student Card Initiative?” brought together Victor Aguilar Mendez from the European Commission, Harpa Sif Arnarsdóttir from RANNIS and Sergi Martínez Rigol from the University of Barcelona to discuss the roadmap beyond 2027.</p><p>The discussion highlighted three main points:</p><ul><li data-list-item-id="ec04a08fab5a0a15faf6d0537ff166c1e"><strong>Build on strong foundations</strong>. Participants welcomed the ambition to further simplify student mobility and emphasised the importance of building on the progress already achieved. They also noted that digital transformation involves more than technical connections, requiring aligned processes, staff capacity and resources.</li><li data-list-item-id="ec8f6683d0b4c64c36760e88ede263ada"><strong>Give institutions clarity and time to prepare</strong>. Participants highlighted the value of clear information on the <a href="https://erasmus-plus.ec.europa.eu/european-student-card-initiative/about/esci-2028-2034/continuity-and-preparation?">future scope of ESCI+</a>, practical implications and transition arrangements. The European Commission indicated that 2028 and 2029 are envisaged as transition years.</li><li data-list-item-id="e8a2629faf233a9053a3e7c84c25e2248"><strong>Broaden engagement beyond international relations and IT teams</strong>. Participants highlighted the value of involving university leadership, national authorities, governance bodies and research and education networks.</li></ul><h2>Practical exchange at the European Commission stand</h2><p>Three mini-sessions created space for practical discussion and peer exchange at the European Commission stand:</p><ul><li data-list-item-id="ea46800eaa0963f636bf8742a636fe844"><strong>Digital Officers and ESCI Champions</strong>: “Meet and Greet” explored different opportunities for close collaboration and participants discussed faster communication channels, technical sub-groups and ways to strengthen the community of practitioners.</li><li data-list-item-id="e722608eb7be29071793748afb04db370"><strong>ESCI+ timeline: what to expect and when</strong>, focused on preparations in 2026 and plans for 2027. Participants asked for timely communication, hands-on training, transition arrangements and support to integrate future developments with existing systems.</li><li data-list-item-id="e4abeb75d22c4e87d628dd3a9174bdc0a"><strong>How to issue your first European Student Card</strong> introduced the practical tools available to card issuers, including the ESC Router and the ESC Service Manager for listing services available to ESC holders.</li></ul><h2>Poster session: “The European Student Card: Bridging borders for students”</h2><p>The poster attracted strong interest, with ESCI representatives Elodie Ham (EACEA) and Deborah Arnold (NTT DATA) engaging with participants on the ESCI components and discussing the implications of the ESCI+ timeline with those already involved in the initiative as well as with potential newcomers.</p><h2>Session by ESCI Champions: “Erasmus Without Paper: Getting on board with the digitisation of Erasmus+"&nbsp;</h2></div>
<div class="ecl-u-type-bold ecl-u-mb-m">Intro Text</div><div class="eac-hero"><p>We joined more than 7,300 international education professionals from over 100 countries in Glasgow to discuss what comes next for the European Student Card Initiative and share practical guidance with institutions.</p></div>

About TACTILIA<\/strong><\/h2>

At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of SCHUNK, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup.<\/p>

This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now. Your work will directly shape the electronics, actuators, and embedded systems that make that possible.<\/p>

You will join at the moment when the hard engineering questions become real product decisions: how do we make a highly capable robotic hand reliable, manufacturable, serviceable, and simple enough to deploy on a real shop floor?<\/p>

<\/p>

The Role<\/strong><\/h2>

You design the mechanics of our robotic hands \u2014 from the kinematics of a single finger to a complete hand ready for series production.<\/p>

Multiple drives, gear trains, tendons, tactile sensors and electronics have to fit into a human-sized envelope while surviving hundreds of thousands of cycles. Every millimetre matters, and almost every design decision affects another discipline.<\/p>

You work hands-on between CAD, test rig and workshop, and report to the CTO.<\/p>

<\/p>

What you will do:<\/strong><\/h2>

  • CAD design.<\/strong> Design components, mechanisms and assemblies within tightly constrained envelopes, owning the design from concept through production release.<\/p><\/li>

  • Mechanism & kinematics.<\/strong> Design finger and thumb kinematics, tendon and spindle drives, joints and bearings. Calculate motion envelopes, trajectories, gripping forces and transmission ratios.<\/p><\/li>

  • Calculation & validation.<\/strong> Validate designs through structural and fatigue calculations, FEA, tolerance stack-ups and GD&T before parts are manufactured.<\/p><\/li>

  • Material selection.<\/strong> Select and qualify materials for lightweight structures, wear surfaces, tendons and elastomeric gripping surfaces, and characterise their behaviour under real loads and contact conditions.<\/p><\/li>

  • Assembly design.<\/strong> Design assemblies for efficient assembly, adjustment-free interfaces, serviceability and repair. Specify the required fixtures and tooling.<\/p><\/li>

  • Design for manufacturing.<\/strong> Design for the intended manufacturing process from the outset \u2014 machining, injection moulding, sheet metal, additive manufacturing \u2014 balancing cost, tolerances and production volumes.<\/p><\/li>

  • Prototyping & testing.<\/strong> Build prototypes, design test rigs and endurance setups, run cycle and load tests, and drive failures to root cause.<\/p><\/li>

  • Documentation & release.<\/strong> Create drawings and BOMs, manage design changes and configuration, and support product development reviews.<\/p><\/li>

  • Suppliers & production.<\/strong> Work with machine shops, material suppliers and manufacturing partners from first prototype through pilot series and production ramp-up.<\/p><\/li>

  • Cross-functional integration.<\/strong> Work closely with Electronics, Sensors and Software to align packaging, interfaces and load paths across the complete system.<\/p><\/li><\/ul>

    What you bring:<\/strong><\/h2>

    • Degree in mechanical engineering, mechatronics, precision engineering, or a comparable qualification.<\/p><\/li>

    • 5\u201310 years of experience in mechanical design of precision mechatronic products, including at least one product taken through to series production.<\/p><\/li>

    • Advanced 3D CAD skills in CATIA, NX, SolidWorks, Creo or comparable systems, with confident 2D drawing creation and GD&T.<\/p><\/li>

    • Strong understanding of mechanism design: linkages, gear trains, bearings, shafts, power transmission, backlash and stiffness.<\/p><\/li>

    • Experience with FEA, structural and fatigue analysis, and tolerance calculations as part of everyday design work.<\/p><\/li>

    • Strong knowledge of material selection for lightweight, high-load and wear-critical components.<\/p><\/li>

    • Practical DFM\/DFA experience across multiple manufacturing processes.<\/p><\/li>

    • Hands-on mentality \u2014 you build the prototype, run the test and analyse the broken part yourself.<\/p><\/li>

    • Fluent in English and German.<\/p><\/li><\/ul>

      Bonus:<\/strong><\/h2>

      • Experience with robotic hands, grippers, prosthetics or similarly highly integrated mechanisms.<\/p><\/li>

      • Experience with compact drive trains, including planetary, harmonic or cycloidal gearing, spindle drives and actuator integration.<\/p><\/li>

      • Experience with elastomers, soft goods, injection moulding of complex geometries or compliant structures.<\/p><\/li>

      • Experience integrating tactile or force sensors into mechanical structures.<\/p><\/li>

      • Experience with multi-body simulation or topology optimisation.<\/p><\/li>

      • Knowledge of Machinery Regulation, ISO\/TS 15066 and mechanical design for collaborative applications.<\/p><\/li><\/ul>

        <\/p>

        The next chapter of robotics won't be built in a lab. It will be built by people who care about what happens when technology meets the real world.<\/p>

        At TACTILIA, you'll work on one of the hardest open problems in robotics: giving machines the dexterity, reliability and robustness to interact with the physical world at industrial scale.<\/p>

        The technology is taking shape, the team is being built, and the standards around robotic hands and their skills are still open. That means your decisions will have a lasting impact \u2014 not just on a product, but on what comes next for Physical AI.<\/p>

        Build the hand. Define the standard. Shape what comes next.<\/strong><\/p>

        If you're excited by the challenge of building robotic hands that works reliably in the real world, we'd love to hear from you.<\/p>

About You

Do you have a passion for the healthcare and pharmaceutical industry?

Do you want to work across a mix of strategy consulting projects that draw from competitor, customer, medical and commercial insights?

Are you a highly motivated professional interested in being part of a dynamic team of self-starters, working with global healthcare and pharmaceutical clients across the full product life cycle?

If so, consider turning your expertise into a valuable career at Prescient. We welcome applications from experienced life science consultants with a track record of leading client engagements and developing teams to join our growing Competitive Strategy practice.

About Our Competitive Strategy Practice

Prescient has four core practices: Commercial, Competitor Intelligence, Medical, and Value, Pricing and Access. We specialise in supporting our biopharma clients in making insightful strategic choices for their products and portfolios. Our offerings are designed to anticipate and respond to competitive risk across the product life cycle – from early pipeline through post-launch – delivering timely insights and strategic implications that enable integrated decision making across competitive intelligence, marketing, medical and commercial functions.

The Competitive Strategy practice is on an exciting journey to expand our customer-centric team. When you join this exciting venture, you will work with global healthcare and pharmaceutical clients across the full product life cycle, from discovery to loss of exclusivity, to help them unlock the full potential of their brands and portfolios.

As a Principal, you will spend approximately 80% of your time on project delivery and team leadership and 20% on business development, primarily within existing accounts.

About the Opportunity

You will be part of a fast-growing PE-backed business that allows high-performing employees to make an impact and contribute to growing the business. You will have the chance to channel your experience and know-how into supporting the development and commercialization of our clients’ assets and portfolios.

As a Principal, you will lead multiple concurrent engagements end to end – from scoping and design through to final recommendations – with considerable independence. You will lead and develop a team of Engagement Managers, Consultants and Analysts, typically including direct reports, and will be accountable for the quality, timeliness and profitability of the work you oversee.

You will act as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders, shaping the strategic questions our projects are designed to answer, and will partner with Directors and Vice Presidents to grow accounts through our “land and expand” model. You will also help build the practice by participating in or leading internal initiatives such as team training, new methodologies and tools.

Key Responsibilities

  • Reporting: Report to a Director or Vice President within the Competitive Strategy practice, ensuring clear communication on project portfolio progress, risks, resourcing and account opportunities
  • Project Leadership and Delivery:
    • Lead multiple concurrent competitive strategy and competitive intelligence engagements end to end, owning design, planning, client and people management, evidence collection, analysis and reporting
    • Work with clients to ensure projects are designed to answer the right strategic business questions, and ensure deliverables meet Prescient’s quality standards, timelines and budgets
  • Client Management:
    • Serve as the lead day-to-day relationship holder for client stakeholders, establishing yourself as a credible strategic advisor who anticipates needs and brings a clear point of view
    • Lead challenging client conversations – including scope changes, expectation setting and course corrections – balancing client satisfaction with commercial discipline
  • Business Development and Account Growth:
    • Identify, scope and convert new opportunities within existing accounts, leading proposal development and contributing to pricing
    • Contribute to strategic account plans alongside Directors and Vice Presidents, and pursue opportunities with new brands within existing clients
  • Subject Matter and Therapeutic Area Expertise:
    • Act as a valued subject matter expert externally on the clinical, regulatory and commercial aspects of your therapeutic area(s), and serve as a knowledge resource to internal teams
    • Apply a working knowledge of FDA, EMA and other relevant regulatory guidelines to sharpen competitive insights and implications
  • People Leadership: Line manage, coach and develop Engagement Managers, Consultants and Analysts; support recruitment in coordination with the talent acquisition team; and ensure a sustained focus on delivering concise, impactful insights
  • Practice Development: Participate in or lead internal initiatives that advance Prescient’s capabilities, such as team training, new methodologies and tools, and ensure technology and data & analytics are embedded across programmes
  • Thought Leadership: Contribute to thought leadership content, in collaboration with senior leaders and the marketing team, that strengthens Prescient’s brand and business development activities
  • Conference and External Engagement: Plan and lead conference coverage for your accounts, directing team coverage and engaging with a wide range of experts and delegates at priority symposia, presentations, posters and booths

Essential Skills and Experience

  • Significant experience in biopharma consulting or client services, typically 8 or more years in life sciences research, analytics or consulting; CI experience is strongly preferred and a mix of industry and consulting experience is a plus
  • Strong results orientation with a proven track record of:
  • Leading multiple engagements end to end, delivering high-quality outputs on time and within budget
  • Managing and developing team members, ideally including 2 or more years of direct-report experience
  • Contributing to business development, including shaping proposals and growing existing accounts
  • Deep expertise in one or more therapeutic areas – oncology, immunology or biosimilars experience is strongly preferred – including the clinical, regulatory and commercial dynamics of US and EU markets
  • Working knowledge of Good Clinical Practice (GCP), FDA, EMA and other relevant regulatory guidelines
  • Strong client management skills:
    • Credibility to engage senior client stakeholders as a trusted advisor and lead discussions on findings and their strategic implications
    • Experience managing scope and expectations against an agreed statement of work, keeping clients satisfied while maintaining commercial discipline
    • Ability to recognize and act on opportunities to expand Prescient’s support within an account
  • Confident communication skills, with the ability to distill complex matters into a clear business case and actionable recommendations for clients and internal teams
  • Ability to dive “in the weeds” while pulling back to see the big picture
  • Demonstrated leadership ability, with a willingness to make decisions and own the follow-through
  • Ability to give and receive feedback constructively
  • Strong learning agility to navigate ambiguity, adapt to change and rapidly acquire new therapeutic or methodological expertise
  • BA/BS required; an advanced degree in a life science discipline is preferred

What We Offer

  • A competitive package and remuneration linked to performance
  • A strong values-based culture grounded in collaboration, curiosity and excellence
  • Tailored career development based on your interests and aspirations – not a one-size-fits-all approach
  • A team of smart, supportive colleagues who invest in each other’s success
  • Leaders who are accessible, ambitious for the team and committed to mentorship
  • An opportunity to lead client engagements and teams, and to help shape our growing Competitive Strategy practice
  • A flexible working schedule and recognition for outstanding contributions
  • A flat hierarchy that empowers you to take ownership and make an impact

About Prescient Healthcare Group

Prescient® is a pharma services firm specializing in dynamic decision support and product and portfolio strategy. We partner with our clients to turn science into value by helping them understand the potential of their molecules, shaping their strategic plans and allowing their decision making to be the biggest differentiating factor in the success of their products. When companies partner with Prescient, the molecules in their hands have a greater potential for success than the same science in the hands of their competitors.

Founded in 2007, Prescient is a global firm with a footprint in 10 cities across three continents. Our team of nearly 475 experts partners with 27 of the top 30 biopharmaceutical companies, the fastest-growing mid-caps and cutting-edge emerging biotechs, including some of the biggest and most innovative brands. More than 70% of our employees hold advanced life science degrees, and our teams deliver an impressive depth of therapeutic, clinical and commercial expertise.

The annual full time base salary range for this role is ($145,000 - $175,000). Specific compensation is determined through interviews and a review of relevant education, experience, training, skills, geographic location and alignment with market data. Additionally, positions may be eligible to receive a discretionary bonus as determined by bonus program guidelines. Prescient offers PTO and paid holidays, the terms of which are set forth in the program policies. All full-time employees also are eligible to participate in various benefit plans, including medical, dental, vision, life, disability insurance and 401K; in each case in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.

Prescient has been a portfolio company of Bridgepoint Development Capital since 2021 and Baird Capital since 2017. For more information, please visit .

We are an equal opportunity employer and fully comply with applicable legislation in all of the geographies in which we operate. Applicants are considered for positions without regard to veteran status, uniformed service member status, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information or any other category protected by applicable national, federal, state or local laws.

Don’t meet every job requirement? That’s okay! Our company is dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If you’re excited about this role, but your experience doesn’t perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.

About the Role

    Provectus is an AI consultancy founded in 2010 and led by its founders. As an AWS Premier Partner and an Anthropic Preferred Partner, we help Financial Services & Insurance and Healthcare & Life Sciences companies design, build, and operate production AI systems. With offices across North America, LATAM, and EMEA, we work with clients worldwide.

    We are hiring an Account Executive to turn incoming enterprise leads into signed consulting engagements. Clients buy multi-month consulting engagements. You won't build pipeline from scratch. Anthropic and AWS share qualified enterprise leads with us.

    Your job has four parts:

    • Qualify those leads quickly.

    • Run discovery with buyers at banks, insurers and life sciences companies.

    • Scope the work with our architects.

    • Close.

What You'll Do

    • Pick up new leads as they arrive, decide which to pursue, and be able to explain why

    • Run discovery calls with business and technology leaders. Map their process, data, regulatory constraints, budget and decision path

    • Work with delivery leads and architects to scope proposals and SOWs that we can deliver. You are selling consulting engagements, not software licenses

    • Negotiate and close to a signed SOW, with the Chief Commercial Officer joining larger deals

    • Run the full sales cycle: discovery, solution scoping, proposal, negotiation, close

    • Translate Anthropic's product roadmap and partnership incentives into the client propositions

    • Keep Anthropic and AWS partner reps informed on the leads they share, and take part in joint pipeline reviews

    • Keep the CRM current and forecast your deals accurately

    • Bring buyer objections and patterns from each industry back to leadership and marketing

    • Travel for client meetings, up to 30% of your time

What You Need

    • 2–4 years in a client-facing commercial role in a consulting or IT services firm where you closed deals yourself, such as account executive, account manager, or consultant who owned client sales. Be ready to share the specifics: what you closed, at what size, and how long each deal took

    • OR experience with banks, insurers, or pharma/biotech companies in one of these roles: selling services or technology to them (including smaller deals you closed yourself or larger deals where you supported the lead); working on client projects at a consulting firm, including proposals or scoping; or working inside one of these companies on projects where you helped evaluate and select outside vendors

    • Working knowledge of Financial Services (banking, insurance, capital markets) or Life Sciences (pharma, biotech). You have worked in the industry or sold into it, and you can discuss a buyer's process and regulatory constraints in their terms

    • Experience selling services engagements or complex B2B deals with several stakeholders

    • Clear written and spoken communication with director-, VP- and C-level buyers

    • Comfort handling a steady volume of leads and choosing where to spend your time

Nice to Have

    • Experience selling AI/ML, data or cloud services

    • Experience working partner-referred leads from Anthropic, AWS, GCP or Azure

Why this role is worth your time

    • Leads arrive every day, so your time goes into closing rather than prospecting

    • You learn enterprise AI consulting sales in two regulated industries

    • You close with support: our architects scope the work with you, and the Chief Commercial Officer joins larger negotiations

    • The delivery team can execute what you sell: 350+ people, 150+ certified architects, and 100+ customers in production

    • Work at the intersection of two AI partnerships: Anthropic and AWS

    • High-impact role with direct visibility to leadership

Compensation and benefits

    • Base $90–120K + commission, OTE range $140–170K. The salary range is determined through interviews and a review of the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, and alignment with market data

    • B2B contract model or full-time model

    • Unlimited vacation policy

    • Generous health, vision, and dental insurance, and life insurance

    • 401(k) matching plan

Our Process

    1. A 30/45-minute call with our recruiter

    2. An interview with the AE about a deal you closed

    3. An interview with the Chief Commercial Officer

Overview

The Principal Healthcare Consultant will play a central role in helping our clients to execute strategies to help them compete and win. We partner with health plans to adapt their product strategies to the evolving needs of their clients, creating offerings that strengthen and sustain their competitive advantage. The Principal works alongside plan client leaders in product management and line-of-business leadership to deliver on this opportunity: designing competitively differentiated benefits and services products for employer groups with highly tailored needs and finding where such investments can create leverage across books of business.

The Principal then leads engagements alongside our other consultants to execute this strategy, translating it into technology and operational designs, and enabling them within the plan's ecosystem. Strategic product thinking paired with practical execution is what sets us apart from traditional consulting firms. The Principal will be instrumental in achieving this balance, advising executive clients to set product strategies that can win share in the market, while ensuring that client staff and NASCO successfully execute the strategy to achieve desired goals.

Responsibilities

  • Advises health plan executives on product strategy and innovation, helping them decide what to bring to market, when, and for which segments
  • Leads product strategy engagements from framing through executive readout, including portfolio review, product concept definition, and prioritized roadmaps
  • Defines and designs competitive health plan products, including benefit and plan design, network and pricing constructs, and funding arrangements, working with plan product, actuarial, finance, and sales partners to balance cost, value, and feasibility
  • Helps plans respond to highly tailored employer group needs, identifying where group requirements can be met through configurable offerings rather than one-off builds and where product investments create leverage across books of business through shared capabilities and sequencing that reduce costs and shorten time to market
  • Assesses market, regulatory, and competitive dynamics, including national carrier positioning, to shape offerings that differentiate rather than follow
  • Translates product strategy into executable plans, targets, success measures, and timelines aligned to plan years, rate filings, and bid cycles
  • Leads engagement on strategic work, directing the contributions of other consultants who take plans through operational design, configuration, and enablement within the plan's ecosystem
  • Participates in strategic pre-sales pursuits alongside commercial leaders, leading executive discoveries, framing customer problems, and establishing the value case before solutions are positioned
  • Develops practice points of view and reusable frameworks on health plan product strategy and innovation, working with the Market Intelligence team to ground them in current market data, and builds our reputation as a strategic partner by sharing them through customer forums, industry events, and published perspectives, including case studies and proof points of customer outcomes
  • Shares customer and market insight with product management to inform roadmap priorities and positioning

Qualifications

Preferred Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Consulting or advisory experience serving health plans
  • Experience at a Blue Cross Blue Shield plan or national carrier, or familiarity with Blues plan operations and inter-plan programs
  • Product leadership across multiple lines of business, including Medicare Advantage product development and bid experience
  • Familiarity with core payer administration platforms and how platform capabilities enable or constrain product design
  • Published perspectives, industry speaking, or recognized thought leadership in health plan product strategy

Experience

  • 5 years of experience working on or with health plans

  • Experience engaging with executive stakeholders and influencing strategic business decisions
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives involving multiple business functions and stakeholder groups

Required Training, Certification and Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, Business Administration, Public Health, Finance, Marketing, or a related field or equivalent experience

Preferred Training, Certification and Education

  • Master’s degree in business administration, Healthcare Administration, Public Health, or a related field
  • Advanced coursework or formal training in innovation, portfolio management, or healthcare transformation

Working Conditions

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

What You Will Do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. The Amgen Foundation is the main philanthropic arm of the biotechnology company Amgen, Inc.

  • Shadow and support our team to learn about the Amgen Foundation’s signature global programs; participate in short-term projects
  • Support the Foundation’s management of its global communications strategy and operations

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The curious individual we seek is a collaborative team member with these qualifications:

What You Can Expect of Us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

The base pay range for this opportunity in the U.S. is $28.87 per hour.

About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

Toptal is an innovative organization that is disrupting the global professional services and talent market. In response to our clients’ overwhelming demand for exceptional talent in new areas, we are expanding the breadth and depth of our Technology Services offerings, including Hybrid Cloud and DevOps, to fuel the next phase of growth. As a Practice Director for Toptal’s Cloud Services practice, you will lead and develop the team of solution architects who design, sell, and deliver hybrid cloud and DevOps solutions for our clients.

You will set the technical vision and standards for the team, shape the solutions it takes to market, and be empowered to work across organizational lines to build a world-class architecture practice. This leader will be a proven expert in hybrid cloud infrastructure and modern DevOps practices, and a proven people leader who has built and managed teams of solution architects or senior technical consultants. The right candidate will understand target buyers, their priorities, and the trends impacting them. Their knowledge will inform which solutions the team builds out, how we scope and package what we do, and how we create a competitive value proposition now and in the future to meet changing market needs.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US at the time of hire. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

You will be responsible for leading Toptal’s Cloud Services Team. This includes:

  • Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and grow a team of solution architects. Set clear goals, give regular feedback, and build a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous learning.
  • Hiring Talent: Recruit, onboard, and retain top solution architects, and ensure the team has the right skills in the right capacities (e.g., hybrid cloud, Kubernetes, Infrastructure-as-Code, CI/CD, SRE, security) to meet market demand.
  • Architecture Standards: Define reference architectures, design patterns, and best practices for hybrid cloud and DevOps solutions, and review the team’s solution designs for quality, security, scalability, and cost-efficiency.
  • Pre-Sales Leadership: Partner with Sales to assess client needs, define solution approaches, and shape proposals and technical presentations. Ensure architects are matched to the right opportunities, and lead key client conversations yourself.
  • Solution Development: Work with practice and delivery leadership to turn repeatable solutions into scalable offerings, such as hybrid cloud architecture and migration, landing zones, container platforms, Infrastructure-as-Code, CI/CD and DevSecOps, SRE and observability, and FinOps.
  • Delivery: Partner with Delivery to ensure designs are implemented successfully. Guide engineering teams through complex technical decisions, and step in directly on critical engagements.
  • Capacity and Performance: Plan team capacity, manage workload and utilization across opportunities and engagements, and track key team metrics such as pipeline support, win rate, and client satisfaction.
  • Partnerships: Build relationships with key technology and cloud partners (e.g., AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, VMware/Broadcom, Red Hat, HashiCorp) and keep the team’s certifications and partner alignment current.
  • Thought Leadership: Stay current on hybrid cloud, platform engineering, and DevOps trends; contribute to marketing content that builds the team’s reputation with clients and in the market.
  • Hands-On Contribution: Remain hands-on by owning architecture for strategic accounts and building proofs of concept, modeling the standard you expect from the team.

This role is highly collaborative and will work extremely closely with our Marketing, Sales, Delivery, and Talent Operations teams to fulfill the above responsibilities.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal; meet your colleagues and the Solution Architects on your team.
  • Learn about Toptal’s history, culture, and vision, with a focus on the state of our industry, Toptal’s operating model, and the core messages important to Toptal.
  • Shadow critical teams throughout the organization to learn Toptal’s core operations and capabilities.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Begin developing relationships with key leaders and stakeholders across the organization.
  • Dive deeper into the operations of key teams (e.g., Sales, Talent Operations) across the company.
  • Conduct a comprehensive review of current demand in your practice area, talent that already exists in the network, active engagements, and any work we may already be doing or have done.
  • Assess the skills, strengths, and development needs of your Solution Architects.
  • Articulate a hypothesis about how to grow the team’s impact (priorities, structure, and standards) and design experiments and execution approaches to get there.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Be a well-integrated member of the organization with positive relationships in Sales (Enterprise/SMB), Marketing, and Talent Operations.
  • Be in front of clients on a regular basis to hear from them firsthand.
  • Define the team’s operating model, architecture standards, and pre-sales engagement process.
  • Build your team and begin positively impacting revenue growth.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Have moved from purely planning to execution.
  • See an impact from your involvement in early initiatives, including repeatable solutions in market and a growing pipeline supported by your team.
  • Establish key partner relationships and a clear hiring and talent plan for the team.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Feel like you made the best decision of your career.
  • Increase the growth rate of Toptal materially.
  • Have a high-performing, fully staffed Solution Architect team recognized for Hybrid Cloud and DevOps expertise.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required; an MBA is preferred.
  • 15+ years of experience in cloud, infrastructure, or DevOps engineering and architecture, with at least 5+ years leading teams of solution architects or senior engineers within cloud or technology services.
  • 3+ years managing a business or team, preferably with P&L or budget responsibility, and a proven track record of overseeing financial performance, identifying areas for improvement, and driving profitability and growth.
  • Proven experience leading and developing teams of solution architects or senior technical consultants.
  • Proven ability to build and scale hybrid cloud and DevOps service offerings in a consulting, managed services, technology services, or enterprise environment.
  • Deep expertise in hybrid and multi-cloud architecture across AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including connectivity, identity, governance, and workload placement across on-premises, private cloud, and public cloud environments.
  • Strong experience with data center and virtualization platforms (e.g., VMware, Nutanix, Hyper-V) and hybrid cloud technologies (e.g., Azure Arc, AWS Outposts, Google Distributed Cloud).
  • Deep knowledge of cloud-native technologies, including containerization and orchestration (Kubernetes, OpenShift, Docker), serverless computing, and microservices architecture.
  • Strong experience with Infrastructure-as-Code and configuration management tools such as Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, or Pulumi.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, GitOps, and automation frameworks (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Argo CD).
  • Expertise in DevOps and platform engineering practices, including DevSecOps, site reliability engineering (SRE), observability, and the use of delivery metrics (e.g., DORA) to drive improvement.
  • Experience with cloud migration and application modernization strategies, disaster recovery, and business continuity in hybrid environments.
  • Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks and practices (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2, CIS), including identity and access management, encryption, and policy-as-code.
  • Knowledge of FinOps and cloud cost optimization, and of emerging trends such as AI-enabled infrastructure and operations, and edge computing.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., AWS, Azure, or GCP Architect; CKA/CKAD; Terraform Associate) are a plus.
  • Ability to develop strong relationships with enterprise clients and executives to drive hybrid cloud and DevOps consulting engagements.
  • Proven ability to lead collaboratively and operate in a high-growth environment.
  • Skilled in articulating a strategy with a strong, agile execution plan.
  • Comfortable with rolling up your sleeves to do the work, demonstrating traction, and building a team over time.
  • Demonstrated success in making data-driven decisions and defining key metrics to measure progress.
  • Ability to walk in the shoes of your audience in order to understand their challenges, develop and execute an approach to solve them, and articulate the solution in a clear and compelling way.
  • Strong ability to translate complex technical concepts into actionable business strategies for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Refined relationship development and leadership skills with a track record of building credibility across all levels of an organization. You can develop positive relationships across the business to partner on key initiatives and gain consensus on processes and strategies.
  • Confidence in your analytical abilities, with proven success in delivering results in ambiguous and sophisticated project efforts.
  • Skilled in the art of communicating (written and verbal) with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Essential Job Functions

  • Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera.
  • Work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Use all required digital collaboration tools.
  • Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines.

US FLSA Classification: Full-Time/Exempt

For candidates who meet the qualifications and job requirements listed above, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. In the US, Toptal’s benefit offerings include participation in a 401(k) retirement plan; medical, dental, and vision health insurance plans; basic life insurance coverage and short-term and long-term disability coverage; access to flexible spending, dependent care, and health savings accounts; access to telehealth virtual doctors; an employee assistance program; and flexible paid time off.

      <title>Squarespace: Staff Software Engineer, Revenue Systems</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Back-End Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> New York City; Remote
</p>

<p>Squarespace is seeking a talented Staff Software Engineer to support and evolve the systems at the core core of our monetization platform: billing, payments and orders. In this role, you will provide technical oversight over the critical monetization machinery that accepts orders, processes payments and bills subscriptions. You will regularly collaborate with engineering leadership and key product, strategy and finance stakeholders to align technical strategy with Squarespace’s business objectives. This is an opportunity to take on IC technical leadership responsibilities and own system architecture for high-visibility initiatives tied directly to Squarespace's core businesses.</p>
<p>This role is open to remote or hybrid working from our NYC office 3 days per week. You will report to the Director of Revenue Systems.</p>
<h2><strong>You'll Get To...</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Own system architectural vision and design for critical areas of our business.</li>
<li>Transform high-level system vision into estimated project plans for initiatives central to Squarespace’s strategy.</li>
<li>Serve as technical lead and cross-functional liaison on business-critical projects, making and defending engineering decisions key to the success of the business.</li>
<li>Mentor engineers on the team to deliver ever greater quality with ever growing autonomy.</li>
<li>Drive best practices for engineering excellence and technical leadership, influence design reviews, question assumptions, point out pitfalls and foster shared understanding</li>
<li>Set the engineering quality bar for the team through regular, high-quality code contributions across billing, orders and payments.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Who We're Looking For</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>10 or more years experience specifying, delivering and maintaining complex distributed backend services.</li>
<li>Significant experience with multiple programming languages (especially Java) and a broad range of tools like Springboot, hibernate, databases, etc.</li>
<li>Demonstrated experience leading system architecture decisions across multiple teams or initiatives</li>
<li>Proven ability to serve as a technical lead on cross-functional projects, aligning engineering and business goals without sacrificing engineering quality</li>
<li>Experience working with billing, orders or payment systems at scale</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Benefits &amp; Perks</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>A choice between medical plans with an option for 100% covered premiums including medical, dental, and vision</li>
<li>Supplemental Life and Disability Insurance plans</li>
<li>Fertility and adoption benefits</li>
<li>Headspace mindfulness app subscription</li>
<li>Global Employee Assistance Program</li>
<li>Retirement benefits with employer match</li>
<li>Flexible paid time off</li>
<li>12 weeks paid parental leave and family care leave</li>
<li>Pretax commuter benefit</li>
<li>Education reimbursement</li>
<li>Employee donation match to community organizations</li>
<li>7 Global Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)</li>
<li>Dog-friendly workplace</li>
<li>Free lunch and snacks</li>
<li>Private rooftop</li>
<li>Hack week twice per year</li>
</ul>
<h3>Cash Compensation Range: $170,000 - $299,000 USD</h3>
<p>The base salary for this position will vary based on job-related criteria including relevant skills, experience, and location, among other factors.</p>
<p>In addition to the cash compensation above (which includes base salary and, where applicable for eligible roles, may include overtime pay), Squarespace employees are eligible to be granted an option to purchase our common stock. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive structure in addition to base salary.</p>
<h2><strong>About Squarespace</strong></h2>
<p>Squarespace is a design-driven platform helping entrepreneurs build brands and businesses online. We empower millions of customers in more than 200 countries and territories with all the tools they need to create an online presence, build an audience, monetize, and scale their business. Our suite of products range from websites, domains, ecommerce, and marketing tools, as well as tools for scheduling with Acuity and creating and managing social media presence with Bio Sites and Unfold. Our team of more than 1,700 is headquartered in New York City, with offices in Dublin, Ireland, and Aveiro, Portugal. For more information about our company, visit <a href="https://www.squarespace.com/about/careers">https://www.squarespace.com/about/careers</a>.</p>
<h2><strong>Our Commitment</strong></h2>
<p>Today, more than a million people around the globe use Squarespace to share different perspectives and experiences with the world. Not only do we embrace and celebrate the diversity of our customers, but we also work toward the same in our employees. At Squarespace, we are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, veteran status, or other class protected by applicable law. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.</p>
<p>#LI-Hybrid</p>
<p>#LI-Remote</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Thank you in advance for providing the following details about your work history from your resume! This helps us ensure that your candidate information is accurate and consistent during the hiring process.</strong></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Squarespace will never solicit your personal banking information or ask you to transfer money in connection with a job offer or interview. We also will not reach out to you via phone or SMS without your permission or knowledge.</strong></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>If you plan to use AI in any capacity during your candidate journey, please review our <span><a href="https://sqsp.link/Sxow3s">Candidate AI Policy</a></span>.</strong></p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/squarespace-staff-software-engineer-revenue-systems">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/squarespace-staff-software-engineer-revenue-systems</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Dremio: Staff Software Engineer - Connectivity</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Portugal - Remote
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Be Part of Building the Future</strong></h2>
<p>Dremio is the unified lakehouse platform for self-service analytics and AI, serving hundreds of global enterprises, including Maersk, Amazon, Regeneron, NetApp, and S&amp;P Global. Customers rely on Dremio for cloud, hybrid, and on-prem lakehouses to power their data mesh, data warehouse migration, data virtualization, and unified data access use cases. Based on open source technologies, including Apache Iceberg and Apache Arrow, Dremio provides an open lakehouse architecture enabling the fastest time to insight and platform flexibility at a fraction of the cost.&nbsp; Learn more at&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="http://www.dremio.com/">www.dremio.com.</a></p></div><p><strong>About the role</strong></p>
<p>Dremio's Connectivity team builds the high-performance connectivity solutions that help customers bring data to Dremio and connect Dremio to the broader data ecosystem. The team works across client drivers, protocols, connectors, interoperability, distributed systems, and the reliability and supportability of production data access.</p>
<p>As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll independently own multiple medium-to-large features or service components within a Connectivity and Clients area. You'll define the approach for a substantial team-area scope, turn ambiguous goals into clear milestones, make sound feature and service-level design decisions, and drive work through reliable production delivery. You will bring deep expertise in at least one area, such as JDBC or ODBC drivers, Apache Arrow ADBC, Arrow Flight SQL, BI interoperability, source connectivity, or connectivity reliability, while contributing effectively across adjacent areas. You will also mentor engineers and influence partner teams through strong technical judgment and execution.</p>
<p><strong>What you'll be doing</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Own substantial connectivity work:</strong> Lead multiple medium-to-large features or service components from problem definition through design, implementation, validation, release readiness, and operational handoff.</li>
<li><strong>Turn ambiguity into an execution plan:</strong> Define reviewable milestones, acceptance measures, dependencies, estimates, and risks for complex customer, product, and engineering goals.</li>
<li><strong>Design scalable, maintainable systems:</strong> Produce technical designs and architecture diagrams, explain trade-offs, and make feature and service-level decisions across drivers, protocols, client libraries, connectors, and distributed services.</li>
<li><strong>Diagnose complex failures:</strong> Lead root-cause analysis across client/server, protocol, network, authentication, metadata, and distributed-system boundaries using logs, telemetry, profiles, benchmarks, and production evidence.</li>
<li><strong>Build compatibility and reliability:</strong> Maintain API and protocol stability; create automated compatibility, interoperability, performance, scale, reliability, observability, and diagnostics coverage; and define practical migration paths for supported and legacy clients.</li>
<li><strong>Collaborate and influence:</strong> Partner with Product, Query Execution, QA, Support, SRE, Documentation, and external technology partners to resolve dependencies and improve certification, customer experience, and supportability.</li>
<li><strong>Raise the engineering bar:</strong> Participate actively in code and design reviews, mentor and coach engineers, improve team practices, and contribute to relevant upstream open-source projects when aligned with Dremio priorities.</li>
<li><strong>Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly:</strong> Apply Dremio-approved AI tools to code comprehension, debugging, test generation, and documentation while protecting proprietary and customer data and validating results through review, testing, and sound engineering judgment.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What we're looking for</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Staff-level ownership:</strong> 8+ years of production software engineering experience, or equivalent depth demonstrated through sustained ownership of complex systems and multiple substantial team-area features.</li>
<li><strong>Programming expertise:</strong> Deep proficiency in Java, C++, Rust, Go, or another systems or services language, with the ability to work effectively in adjacent languages and frameworks.</li>
<li><strong>Connectivity and systems depth:</strong> Experience designing and debugging APIs, protocols, client libraries, drivers, or distributed services, with strong knowledge of data structures, concurrency, asynchronous programming, networking, and failure handling.</li>
<li><strong>Problem-solving ability:</strong> Able to identify and solve non-obvious problems across client/server and distributed-system boundaries and turn findings into durable fixes and regression coverage.</li>
<li><strong>Quality mindset:</strong> Experience building comprehensive unit, integration, compatibility, performance, or reliability tests and working with production CI/CD, packaging, release, certification, and engineering quality controls.</li>
<li><strong>Communication and influence:</strong> Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical trade-offs, surface risks early, align contributors across teams, and influence without formal authority.</li>
<li><strong>Mentorship:</strong> Demonstrated ability to mentor and coach engineers and improve the effectiveness and engineering practices of the team around you.</li>
<li><strong>Education:</strong> Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Advanced degrees and equivalent industry experience are welcomed.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Bonus points if you have</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Experience developing JDBC, ODBC, ADBC, or other database drivers.</li>
<li>Experience with Apache Arrow or Arrow Flight SQL.</li>
<li>Experience with SQL engines, databases, data platforms, or source connectors.</li>
<li>BI interoperability experience with Power BI, Tableau, Excel, or similar tools, including collaboration with partner engineering teams.</li>
<li>Knowledge of OAuth, OIDC, TLS, enterprise authentication, metadata discovery, or query pushdown.</li>
<li>Cross-platform native build, packaging, release engineering, compatibility certification, or upgrade support experience.</li>
<li>Observability, production diagnostics, customer escalation, long-running data transfer, cancellation, keepalive, timeout, or proxy experience.</li>
<li>Contributions to Apache Arrow or other relevant open-source projects.</li>
</ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>What we value&nbsp;</strong></h3>
<p><span>At Dremio, we hold ourselves to high standards when it comes to People, Thinking, and Action. Our Gnarlies (that's what we call our employees) communicate with clarity, drive accountability, and are respectful towards each other. We confront brutal facts and focus on results while operating with a sense of urgency and building a "flywheel". People who like to jump in and drive momentum will thrive in our #GnarlyLife.</span></p>
<p><em><span>Dremio is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other unlawful factor.</span></em></p>
<p><em><span>Dremio is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.</span></em></p>
<p><em><span>Dremio has policies in place to protect the personal information that employees and applicants disclose to us. Please click </span></em><a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1CB96QFmOX-bFy48YFOe2GO5lmdawOpKKBj8DpTgsuNg/edit?usp=sharing"><em><span>here</span></em></a><em><span> to review the privacy notice.&nbsp;</span></em></p>
<h3><strong>Important Security Notice for Candidates</strong></h3>
<p><span>At Dremio, we uphold trust and transparency as paramount values in all our interactions with customers, partners, employees, and the general public. We have been targeted by individuals creating fake domains similar to ours to scam prospects and candidates. Please note that all official communications from us will be from an @dremio.com domain. If you suspect you've been targeted by a scam, it's imperative to report the incident to your local law enforcement agencies. For more information about this type of scam, please refer to Dremio's official statement&nbsp;<a href="https://www.dremio.com/blog/stay-alert-for-fraudulent-recruitment-attempts-that-falsely-claim-association-with-dremio/">here</a>.</span></p>
<p><em>Dremio is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with the Company.</em></p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/dremio-staff-software-engineer-connectivity">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/dremio-staff-software-engineer-connectivity</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Twikey: Senior Java Developer</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Back-End Programming</category>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0017/1267/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Ghent - Belgium
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://www.twikey.com/jobs">https://www.twikey.com/jobs</a>
</p>

<p>Are you a driven back-end developer who doesn't wait for instructions, but is already thinking two steps ahead? Who experiments with new technologies and smart solutions alongside the job? Then we want to talk to you.</p>
<p><strong>Straight forward but clear: Twikey isn't looking for someone to just execute. We're looking for someone who thinks, does and keeps going when the going gets tough.</strong></p>
<p>Because fintech is evolving at breakneck speed. That calls for real ownership and for someone who can dive deep on the technical side to keep innovating and improving our platform. You get plenty in return, such as the freedom and responsibility to deliver your own projects. Thanks in part to our organisational structure, you can shape your ideas in the short term and see the results of your hard work quickly.</p>
<p>Driven by your passion for building scalable, performant and secure back-end systems, you continuously raise the bar for your own skills and for our product.</p>
<p>As a member of our development team you work closely with our CTO, 3 fellow developers and 2 testers on the core of our software application. A small, strong team in which you take on a role with real impact on the future of our product.</p>
<ul>
<li>You focus on&nbsp;<strong>developing and improving the back-end</strong>&nbsp;of our platform, optimising the architecture and data processing while keeping the security and stability of our system in mind. This lets you put your technical skills to full use and come up with innovative solutions.</li>
<li>With your expertise you'll&nbsp;<strong>make valuable suggestions and streamline processes</strong>&nbsp;for all our stakeholders, so we can work more efficiently and achieve better results.</li>
<li>You provide&nbsp;<strong>technical support on integration projects</strong>&nbsp;with software houses, banks and large companies, solving complex technical problems. That gives you the chance to work on challenging projects and to get in touch with a wide range of technologies and industries.</li>
</ul>
<p>Once you know our product inside out, there are plenty of challenging projects for you to help build.</p>
<h4 class="sec-title-9">What are we looking for in you?</h4>
<ul>
<li>You are&nbsp;<strong>driven, curious and enterprising.</strong>&nbsp;Not only in your job, but outside of it too. You have a&nbsp;<strong>pro-active attitude</strong>&nbsp;and are always a few steps ahead: you spot opportunities, grab them and get to work.</li>
<li>Technical challenges? You take them on, not because you have to, but because you want to&nbsp;<strong>learn</strong>. You're a&nbsp;<strong>self-starter</strong>&nbsp;and quickly get to grips with new technologies, languages or frameworks.</li>
<li>You understand that a good product is never "finished". You draw energy from that&nbsp;<strong>mix of creating and fine-tuning</strong>. You think along, question things and keep building new solutions.</li>
<li>You have experience using AI tools to build integrations. You're&nbsp;<strong>actively exploring how AI can contribute</strong>&nbsp;to smarter user experiences and more efficient software development. Experience with data analytics is an asset.</li>
<li>You therefore attach&nbsp;<strong>a lot of importance to the security, stability and reliability</strong>&nbsp;of a system and know what it takes to get there. You work in a structured, meticulous way and write code that is clean, reusable and easy to test.</li>
<li>You have demonstrable experience with&nbsp;<strong>Java, Go and the Spring framework</strong>. Experience with API integrations, web services, Linux or other relevant areas is a plus.</li>
<li>You have&nbsp;<strong>a deep understanding of databases.</strong>&nbsp;You don't just know how to use them, you know how they work. You have an opinion on structured, high-quality code, architecture and back-end technologies.</li>
<li>You have a very good command of&nbsp;<strong>English</strong>, for smooth collaboration with all colleagues and stakeholders. Dutch is an asset.</li>
<li>You are based in a time zone within&nbsp;<strong>one hour of CET</strong>, so your working day overlaps with the team's for the daily stand-ups and close day-to-day collaboration.</li>
<li>You can work independently and enjoy a small team where switching gears quickly, collaboration and knowledge sharing are central.</li>
</ul>
<h4 class="sec-title-9">Twikey offers you:</h4>
<ul>
<li>An environment where challenge, innovation and autonomy come first.</li>
<li>The room to&nbsp;<strong>experiment, to challenge and to improve.</strong>&nbsp;And we expect you to really take that room.</li>
<li>An ideal setting if you want to grow fast and healthily, both technically and personally. Training, ownership, taking on new or additional roles based on your talents and interests, ... a lot is possible here, and you're at the wheel!</li>
<li>A&nbsp;<strong>complementary team of more than 35 colleagues</strong>&nbsp;who move forward together in a respectful and open atmosphere.</li>
<li>A motivating workplace with&nbsp;<strong>plenty of knowledge and expertise</strong>, shared both formally during the daily stand-ups and the weekly Friday call, and informally at the coffee machine.</li>
<li><strong>Appreciation, openness and critical dialogue.</strong>&nbsp;Our Friction Hunter Trophy is an example: every month we celebrate the colleague who made the biggest difference for customers, teammates or internally. Your impact gets noticed!</li>
<li>A modern workplace with different zones (conference, connect, co-work, concentrate) in a recently built, industrial-style office building. Easy to reach by car, by bike and by public transport on the edge of Ghent, right next to the KBC tower.</li>
<li>A&nbsp;<strong>salary package tailored</strong>&nbsp;to your experience and skills, with plenty of extra-legal benefits, a collective bonus system and a cafeteria plan to convert your 13th month as you choose.</li>
<li>The chance to work in an&nbsp;<strong>innovative Belgian fintech scale-up</strong>&nbsp;that is active in several countries, in a sector that is growing fast!</li>
</ul>
<p>A job ad doesn't tell you everything. Our colleagues tell you&nbsp;<a class="link" href="https://www.twikey.com/jobs/testimonials.html">here</a> what it's really like to work at Twikey.</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/twikey-senior-java-developer">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/twikey-senior-java-developer</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Mixpanel: Customer Value Architect III</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, US
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Mixpanel</strong></p>
<p>Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at <a href="https://mixpanel.com/home/">mixpanel.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>About the Team</strong></p>
<p>The Customer Value Architects team sits inside the revenue organization and owns the connection between what customers buy and what they actually get out of Mixpanel. We turn product usage into measurable business outcomes, working across onboarding, adoption, and renewal to make sure customers see the value they signed up for.</p>
<p><strong>About the Role</strong></p>
<p>The right candidate is a relationship-first advisor who connects a customer's Mixpanel investment to real outcomes for a defined book of accounts. You'll own the adoption and value plan for each account end to end: understanding why the customer bought Mixpanel, tracking whether they're getting the ROI they expected, and driving the enablement and product usage that gets them there. You'll build trusted relationships with business and technical stakeholders, partner closely with your Account Executive and renewal counterparts, and bring a growing point of view on how customers should think about AI in their product workflows. This role suits someone who can own a project end to end and is ready to start extending their influence beyond their own accounts to the wider team.</p>
<p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Own the value plan for each account in your portfolio, connecting the business problem that led the customer to buy Mixpanel with the outcomes they measure.</li>
<li>Build relationships with business and technical stakeholders, aligning Mixpanel's capabilities to what customers care about most.</li>
<li>Run discovery on customer priorities and pain points, and turn what you learn into concrete adoption plans and internal updates.</li>
<li>Partner with your Account Executive on expansion and your renewal counterpart on renewal execution, bringing the value case and adoption evidence that supports both.</li>
<li>Lead enablement/best practices sessions on dashboard design, funnel analysis, and retention modeling to grow how deeply and widely a customer uses Mixpanel.</li>
<li>Monitor usage and health signals and lead business reviews that surface what's working, deepen adoption, and catch risk early.</li>
<li>Spot underused features and contracted capabilities, and turn them into clear recommendations for the customer.</li>
<li>Triage product questions and issues, solving what you can and routing the rest to the right team.</li>
<li>Build a working point of view on a customer's AI maturity, and use Mixpanel's own AI surface to help them build on their product data.</li>
<li>Coordinate with GTM, Product, and Engineering on escalations, and share what works with the broader Customer Value Architects team.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>We're Looking For Someone Who Has</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>4 - 6 years of experience in customer success, consulting, or a related field supporting B2B SaaS accounts, or equivalent experience.</li>
<li>A track record of managing relationships across a range of stakeholders, from business partners to technical teams.</li>
<li>The ability to translate technical concepts, like data models and product metrics, into terms that land with non-technical stakeholders.</li>
<li>Experience turning product usage into a clear story about customer outcomes and ROI.</li>
<li>Comfort building and running adoption plans that tie daily work to a customer's larger goals.</li>
<li>Hands-on experience with AI or agentic tooling beyond casual use, such as MCP-based workflows or LLM copilots.</li>
<li>A collaborative approach to working across account teams and internal partners to move plans forward.</li>
